title: DysLexLens：面向低资源场景的LLM框架，用于分析在线论坛中阅读障碍学习者的体验
summary: DysLexLens是一个低资源LLM框架，通过分析Reddit等在线论坛数据，研究阅读障碍学习者使用AI工具的体验。它采用词典驱动过滤、知识图谱推理、定量评估（RAGAS）和定性验证，有效处理噪声数据并生成可验证的查询响应。
summary_en: DysLexLens is a low-resource LLM framework that analyzes dyslexic learners' experiences with AI tools from online forums like Reddit. It uses dictionary-driven filtering, KG-based reasoning, quantitative metrics (RAGAS), and qualitative validation to handle noisy data and generate verifiable responses.
